top_signals.title: Dualog replaces Slack and Teams with Workspace, the platform it built for shipping
top_signals.summary: Maritime software provider Dualog has moved all of its internal messaging and file sharing from Slack and Teams to Workspace, the ship-shore collaboration platform it recently introduced to shipping companies. top_signals.title: Zhoushan bunker operations halted at outer anchorages amid typhoon threat
top_signals.summary: Bunker operations at Zhoushan’s outer anchorages, Tiaozhoumen and Xiazhimen, have been suspended since the weekend due to rough weather caused by three successive cyclones, a source said.
